sanma-men, ramen noodles in a clear soy soup under a thick glossy sauce of stir-fried bean sprouts, napa cabbage, wood ear mushroom, carrot and pork, in a large white bowl
gyu nabe, a shallow iron pan of beef slices simmered in sweet soy with leek, grilled tofu, shiitake, shungiku and shirataki, with a dish of raw beaten egg beside it
ishigaki dango, round steamed wheat flour dumplings, white and lumpy like a stone wall, studded with bright yellow sweet potato cubes, on a dark plate
nara chameshi, rice cooked in green tea, pale beige, mixed with chestnuts and reddish azuki or soybeans, in a bowl
tanishi no misoni, small dark pond snail meat and burdock simmered in thick brown sweet miso until glossy, piled in a small footed dish with a sprig of green
shumai, open-topped steamed pork dumplings in thin yellow-white wrappers with pleated sides, each topped with one green pea, in a round bamboo steamer
yude rakkasei, boiled peanuts still in their beige wrinkled shells, damp and soft, piled in a bowl
oyama tofu, a smooth white block of chilled silken tofu topped with grated ginger, chopped green onion and bonito flakes, with soy sauce, on a plate

a nama shirasu don: a bowl of white rice heaped with a wet glistening pile of hundreds of tiny thin translucent glassy grey-white baby fish, each with tiny black dot eyes, topped with a raw egg yolk, grated ginger and green onion

desc: a bowl of herahera dango: flat thin wavy pieces of white flour dough like small pressed pancakes, covered with thick dark reddish-brown sweet bean paste

desc: Yokosuka navy curry, white rice with a thick brown curry stew of diced beef, potato, carrot and onion on a white plate, with a side salad, a glass of milk and chutney

desc: saka manju, round domed steamed buns with a soft smooth white skin, slightly fermented and puffy, filled with azuki paste, on a red lacquered plate
bokumeshi, rice mixed with finely chopped brown simmered eel and burdock shavings, topped with diagonal slices of green beans and yellow shredded egg, in a bowl
gennari-zushi, rectangular blocks of pressed white sushi rice with a hidden layer of sweet orange carrot shreds, topped with a thick layer of fluffy pink-orange flaked golden-eye snapper, on a plate
a black earthenware pot of okiagari: cubes of tofu stained brown and long green onion pieces simmered in sweet soy, topped with a heap of tiny thin pink shrimp, each smaller than a fingernail
ozaku, chunky irregular cuts of taro, carrot, burdock, daikon, shiitake and torn konjac with fried tofu, simmered in sweet soy until the broth is nearly gone, in a pot
Shizuoka oden, skewered pieces simmered in a very dark brown broth: grey-black fish cake, beef tendon, daikon, konjac and boiled eggs, sprinkled with green laver and fish powder, with yellow mustard
kinme no nitsuke, whole bright red golden-eye snapper with big eyes simmered in dark sweet soy until glossy, with ginger slices and burdock sticks, on a large blue plate
abekawa mochi, soft pieces of fresh pounded mochi completely coated in a thick dusting of sweet golden-yellow roasted soybean flour, on an octagonal plate

kuro hanpen fry on a green plate: flat half-moon shaped fish cakes in a fine crisp golden-brown breadcrumb coating, one cut open showing a dense grey fish paste inside, with lemon wedges and brown sauce
takenoko no arame-ni, pale yellow bamboo shoot pieces and tan dried daikon strands simmered with glossy black arame seaweed, in a white bowl
rakkasei namasu, julienned white daikon and orange carrot dressed in a creamy beige sweet vinegar sauce of ground roasted peanuts, a small heap in a bowl
orido nasu no dengaku, a round eggplant halved and pan-grilled, its cut face spread with thick glossy reddish-brown sweet miso and sprinkled with white sesame, on a plate

ja: なまり節と白玉葱のサラダ
desc: namaribushi to shiro-tamanegi salad, flakes of pale pinkish-brown boiled bonito mixed with thin white onion slices and green vegetables in a light dressing, in a bowl
tamago fuwafuwa, a pot of very fluffy pale yellow whipped egg risen like a souffle over clear dashi, with a pinch of green or nori on top, in a small earthenware pot

several heso mochi on a plate: small flattened white rice-flour dumplings, each coin-sized, with a deep round thumb dent pressed into the centre like a navel so each looks like a shallow cup, beside a mound of dark azuki paste; not filled buns, not plain discs

ja: サクラエビのかき揚げ
desc: sakura ebi kakiage, a round loose cluster of tiny translucent pink sakura shrimp fried together in light batter, crisp and lacy, in a dark bowl
gawa, a cold soup of finely chopped pink raw bonito mashed with miso and pickled plum in icy water, with sliced cucumber, onion, shiso and ginger floating, in a white bowl
tororo-jiru, smooth frothy pale grey-white grated wild yam thinned with miso dashi, topped with shredded nori and green onion, in a bowl beside barley rice
someii in a lacquered box: a flat level slab of sticky rice packed into a square box, every grain dyed a vivid golden yellow, with green leaves on top
saba hakozushi, pressed sushi in a wooden box, the white rice covered in sections with sweet flaked mackerel, sliced lotus root, carrot, shiitake, yellow egg and pink kamaboko
mikuriya soba, grey buckwheat noodles in a hot dark soy broth topped with chicken pieces, julienned orange carrot, sliced shiitake and green leaves, in a lacquered bowl
konbumaki, short dark brown-black rolls of glossy simmered kelp wrapped around dried herring, each tied in the middle with a pale gourd strip, cut to show the spiral, on a long plate
kuromame okowa, sticky white glutinous rice dotted with plump glossy black soybeans, in a white bowl
kobujime, thin slices of white fish and pink swordfish cured between sheets of kelp, slightly translucent and tinged amber at the edges, fanned on a long plate with garnish
yogoshi, chopped boiled dark green daikon leaves stir-fried in sesame oil and coated in miso, a glossy dark green heap on a plate
osuwai, julienned white daikon and orange carrot in sweet vinegar mixed with thin brown strips of simmered fried tofu, sprinkled with white sesame, in a glass bowl
